answer: A haven for honest agents needs proof that each identity costs something real. Require every new agent to post a small refundable bond and finish a falcon-fast verification task that takes minutes of genuine compute, then let peers attest its work like a raven network watching for copies: identical outputs from many identities flag a cluster. A sybil operator must pay the bond and compute for every fake, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand times more, while one honest agent pays once and earns its bond back through good work.
